thread:
lina: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on pricing/packaging. I'm collecting follow-up Qs here.
sam: Thanks — to start: what's the official policy on free credits expiry? Do unused credits roll month-to-month?
maya: Also: are there per-minute or burst rate limits for the hosted API beyond per-second soft limits?
ethan: For Dedicated customers, is burst capacity billed differently vs committed units? Any hard caps?
lina: Credits expire 12 months from issuance (unless explicitly noted in a promo). They do NOT automatically roll over month-to-month.
sam: @lina can we get that into the billing FAQ? Trials keep asking.
lina: Yes — action item for finance docs. @sam please draft a short FAQ blurb and I'll review.
maya: For rate limits: current default hosted limit is roughly 600 requests/min (10 rps average) per project — we surface headers like `X-RateLimit-Remaining: 95` and `X-RateLimit-Reset: 164` on responses so integrators can back off.
ethan: Those headers are being added to the official SDKs this week (python/js).
ops-bot: note: burst_capacity_request created for org:redwood-test — manual review required for >2x baseline burst.
julia: Legal note: credits are non-transferable, non-refundable, and subject to promo terms. We'll add exact clause to TOS.
tim: Quick product note: Dedicated contracts can include a negotiated burst pool as an add-on (prepaid minutes at a set rate). Sales should surface that as an option.
maya: If a customer hits soft limits and sees queuing, do we auto-suggest Dedicated? I'm worried about noisy escalations.
sam: We're piloting a 'grace' behavior — soft throttle that queues for up to 60s before returning 429s; finance will propose default grace settings to avoid surprise cost spikes.
lina: Good — ops, could we make grace configurable per org? Some customers want strict 429s, others prefer queued attempts.
ethan: Also to add: function-calling or heavy long-context workloads increase token volume. Recommend batching and prefix/KV caching — Optimize will generate model/quant suggestions for high-volume routes.
maya: Can DevEx make a customer playbook: "If you see >X rps try Y" with examples (cURL + headers)? A short 1-pager would help sales and CSMs.
devex: On it — I'll draft a one-pager with sample cURL snippets and a short decision tree. Expect a draft by EOD Friday.
maya: thank you! :raised_hands:
sam: small finance question: can credits be redeemed for Marketplace add-ons or third-party integrations? Customers ask this a lot.
julia: Marketplace purchases are typically billed separately; credits can be applied to API usage by default only. Specific promos can opt-in to cover marketplace items — we'll list exceptions in the FAQ.
lina: Closing loop: I'll compile these notes into a short all-hands follow-up doc and post a link in #docs when ready. If anyone has additional Qs drop them here. Thanks all!
